test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The percentage of all of the ingredients in a recipe is shown in the following pie-chart. Study the pie-chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/672b44c42be6aecae34035b666bd42db9ddf6ee47253f991dff719ba649035e0.png] 

If the final mixture of all these ingredients weighs twice of 3,50,000 g, then what is the difference between the weight of flour and almonds?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/672b44c42be6aecae34035b666bd42db9ddf6ee47253f991dff719ba649035e0.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Total weight of the ingredients = 2(3,50,000) = 7,00,000 g

Weight of almonds = 50% of total

Weight of flour = 10% of total

Difference between them

= (50 - 10)%

= 40% of 7,00,000

= 2,80,000 g

**Hence, The Required value of weight is 2,80,000 g.**
